title: Together Room
user: A parent and child who want a 10-minute remote co-op activity without ads, logins, tracking, or an ongoing game-service commitment.
smallest_useful_product: A two-device PWA with three original, turn-based co-op microgames, six-digit room codes, reconnect support, and no account.
success_measure: 50% of created rooms complete two rounds with both devices still connected after 10 minutes.
constraints: No ads, analytics minimization, original game content only, safety-first room expiry, COPPA-aware product design.
